Low brass player and composer Joseph Daley pays tribute to and expands upon the vital music pioneered by Sam Rivers and other creative artists of the 1970s.
Joseph has contributed to New York City music culture as an educator, sideman and leader of groups such as the Earth Tones Ensemble, the Ebony Brass Quintet and the Joseph Daley Tuba Trio.
Joseph was interviewed in Utica, New York on March 18, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
